paragraphs: I'm interested in the process of turning ideas into something real — whether that's software, music, or writing.
This website is a home for selected projects and creative work. It will grow over time as I make, learn, and explore.

projects.title: Odelis
projects.description: A comprehensive learning and productivity platform bringing planning, organization, and learning together.

projects.title: MakeCode Arcade
projects.description: Game development projects and experiments exploring interactive mechanics, movement, and enemy behavior.

projects.title: Interactive Systems
projects.description: A collection of smaller experiments focused on turning ideas into working interactions and systems.

music.title: The Light Is Back
music.description: An emotional, uplifting artcore composition led by piano and orchestral strings, shaped around an E Lydian sound.

music.title: Timeless Flight
music.description: An original piece currently taking shape, with its own musical identity and direction.

music.title: Until We Meet Again
music.description: A short, magical and mysterious cinematic piece imagined for a quiet cutscene and a moment of hopeful reunion.

music.title: A Sight I'll Never Forget
music.description: A developing composition centered around F-sharp, exploring a distinct melodic atmosphere.

music.title: Before Tomorrow
music.description: A musical idea built around a recurring six-note motif, serving as the foundation for a larger piece.

music.title: Grammaria — Boss Theme
music.description: An energetic, dramatic theme for a game encounter, built around bold piano writing and layered strings.
